SKILL_CF_ENCMOD_CURSE_ON_HIT._source: Encounter Modifiers spec §8.2 (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-05-encounter-modifiers-spec.md), verbatim. Owner = the STATUS_CF_ENCMOD_CURSED-bearing enemy, via the §4.4 EntityAdapter.Passives status-passives extension (M-EM2, not yet wired -- this recipe is inert until then, per spec §2 move 3 / M-EM1 scope note).
